# בעיות נפוצות ואיך פותרים אותן

פתרונות למקומות שבהם נתקעים: אזהרות Windows, הטוקן של Cloudflare, Zero Trust, מפתחות שנדחים, כניסה, הורדות ומייל.

עודכן 2026-10-17

## תוכנת ההתקנה

- **Windows protected your PC.** לוחצים **More info** ואז **Run anyway**.
- **האנטי-וירוס מחק את הקובץ.** משחזרים אותו מההסגר של האנטי-וירוס ומאשרים, או מורידים שוב ממייל הרכישה.
- **לחיצה כפולה ושום דבר לא נפתח.** מחכים 20 שניות, הקובץ גדול. תוכנת ההתקנה פותחת לשונית בדפדפן בכתובת שמתחילה ב-`http://127.0.0.1`. אם לא נפתחה לשונית, מעתיקים את הכתובת מהחלון השחור הקטן לדפדפן.
- **מפתח הרישיון נדחה.** מקלידים אותו בצורה `OL-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX` ובודקים את מספר העוסק. המפתח עובד רק למספר שבשבילו נקנה. התקנה חוזרת של אותו עסק עם אותו מפתח עובדת.

## Cloudflare

- **אין Zone Resources.** הוא מופיע רק אחרי שורת הרשאה מסוג Zone. בלי דומיין, מדלגים ומשתמשים בכתובת החינמית של workers.dev. ראו [יצירת ה-API token](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/he/help/cloudflare-token/).
- **Check token נכשל.** ההודעה אומרת איזו הרשאה חסרה. עורכים את הטוקן, מוסיפים את השורה, שומרים ובודקים שוב.
- **Zero Trust או R2 מבקשים כרטיס.** שתי התוכניות החינמיות מבקשות אמצעי תשלום ולא מחייבות.
- **Purchase R2 Plan.** לוחצים ומאשרים את התוכנית החינמית. 10GB הראשונים בחודש בחינם.

## מפתחות

- **מפתח Gemini נדחה.** מפתחות חדשים מ-Google AI Studio מתחילים ב-`AQ.`. תוכנת ההתקנה של גרסה 1.6.0 מ-17 באוקטובר 2026 מקבלת אותם. עם תוכנת התקנה ישנה, בוחרים **No** בקריאת הוצאות ומוסיפים את המפתח אחר כך, ראו [הוספה או החלפה של מפתח](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/he/help/keys-later/).
- **מפתח Anthropic נדחה.** הוא מתחיל ב-`sk-ant-`. מעתיקים אותו שוב מ-console.anthropic.com.

## כניסה

- **עמוד של Cloudflare מבקש מייל.** זו הכניסה. מקלידים את מייל הבעלים ומדביקים את הקוד מהמייל.
- **הקוד לא מגיע.** בודקים בספאם, ובודקים שזה המייל שהוזן בתוכנת ההתקנה.
- **מישהו אחר נעצר בעמוד של Cloudflare.** מוסיפים את המייל שלו ב-Cloudflare Access, ראו [גישה לרואה חשבון](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/he/help/users/).

## הורדות ומייל

- **קישור ההורדה פג או נגמר.** לוחצים **Email me a fresh link** באותו עמוד.
- **לקוחות מקבלים את המסמכים בספאם.** ראו [שליחת מסמכים בלי ספאם](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/he/help/email/).
- **טוקן ה-MCP אבד.** ראו [חיבור Claude](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/he/help/connect-claude/).

## רשות המסים

- **ITA מבקש להתחבר מחדש.** הכניסה תקפה 90 יום. פותחים **ITA** ולוחצים **Connect again**.
- **חשבונית מחכה למספר 24 שעות.** מבקשים את המספר באתר של רשות המסים ומקלידים אותו בעמוד ITA.

עדיין תקועים? [כתבו לנו מעמוד המחירים.](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/he/pricing/#setup)

## עוד עזרה

# עדכונים וגיבויים

איך בודקים אם יש גרסה חדשה של Open Ledger IL ומעדכנים עם תוכנת ההתקנה, ואיפה הלדג'ר שומר גיבויים.

עודכן 2026-10-17

## בדיקת עדכונים

**Settings > Updates > Check for updates.** הלדג'ר בודק גם בכל 1 לחודש. שום דבר לא מותקן לבד.

## עדכון

1. פותחים את קישור ההורדה ממייל הרכישה. אם הוא כבר לא עובד, פותחים אותו בכל זאת ולוחצים **Email me a fresh link**.
2. מריצים את תוכנת ההתקנה החדשה על אותו חשבון Cloudflare, עם אותו מפתח רישיון.
3. היא מעדכנת את הלדג'ר ושומרת הכול: מסד הנתונים, הקבצים, הכניסה והמפתחות.

## גיבויים

- כל רבעון הלדג'ר כותב עותק מלא של מסד הנתונים ורשימה של כל הקבצים ל-bucket הגיבויים שלו, ובודק שהעותק משתחזר.
- כשגוגל דרייב מחובר, אותו עותק נשמר גם בדרייב, מחוץ ל-Cloudflare.
- כל לילה הלדג'ר בודק שאין חורים במספור ושאף מסמך לא השתנה. **Settings > Backups > Run check now** מריץ את הבדיקה מתי שרוצים.

## שומרים על חשבון Cloudflare

חשבון Cloudflare מחזיק את הספרים שלכם. מפעילים אימות דו-שלבי: dash.cloudflare.com, הפרופיל, **Authentication**, **Two-Factor Authentication**.

עדיין תקועים? [כתבו לנו מעמוד המחירים.](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/he/pricing/#setup)

# גישה לרואה חשבון או לעוזר

הוספת רואה חשבון, עוזר או מייל נוסף שלכם ללדג'ר, בלדג'ר וב-Cloudflare Access, והסרה שלהם.

עודכן 2026-10-17

לכל אדם יש תפקיד בכל עסק.

- **Owner (בעלים):** הכול, כולל הגדרות, משתמשים, מספור וחיבור לרשות המסים.
- **Assistant (עוזר):** לקוחות, הצעות מחיר, דרישות תשלום, קבלות, שליחה והוצאות. בלי הגדרות, משתמשים או רשות המסים.
- **Accountant (רואה חשבון):** רואה את מה שאתם מאשרים, עד תאריך סיום. כל פעולה נרשמת. רואה חשבון אף פעם לא מוציא או מבטל מסמך.

## הוספת אדם

שני מקומות, שניהם חובה.

### 1. בלדג'ר

1. בוחרים את העסק בבורר שלמעלה.
2. בתפריט הצד פותחים **Accountant > Users**.
3. לוחצים **Invite someone**.
4. מקלידים מייל ובוחרים תפקיד. לרואה חשבון צריך גם תאריך סיום ומתגים: מסמכי הכנסה, הוצאות, דוחות, החבילה החודשית, מבנה אחיד.
5. לוחצים **Send invite**.

למייל נוסף שלכם בוחרים **Owner**.

### 2. ב-Cloudflare Access

מיילים שהכנסתם בתוכנת ההתקנה כבר שם. לכל אחד חדש:

1. נכנסים ל-dash.cloudflare.com ופותחים **Zero Trust**.
2. נכנסים ל-**Access > Applications** ופותחים את **MTN Open Ledger**.
3. פותחים את הלשונית **Policies** ועורכים את מדיניות הכניסה.
4. תחת **Include > Emails** מוסיפים את המייל.
5. לוחצים **Save**.

עד שלב 5, Cloudflare עוצר את האדם בעמוד הכניסה שלו.

## הסרת אדם

1. בלדג'ר: **Accountant > Users**, לוחצים **Revoke** בשורה שלו.
2. ב-Cloudflare Access: מוחקים את המייל מ-**Include > Emails** ושומרים.

עדיין תקועים? [כתבו לנו מעמוד המחירים.](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/he/pricing/#setup)

## עוד עזרה

- [התקנת Open Ledger IL צעד אחר צעד](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/he/help/install/)
- [יצירת ה-API token ב-Cloudflare](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/he/help/cloudflare-token/)

# Before you install: what you need

The accounts, details and 30 minutes you need before you run the Open Ledger IL installer, and which parts are optional.

Updated 2026-10-17

The install takes about 30 minutes the first time. Most of that is creating accounts. Have these ready before you start.

## Required

- **A Windows computer.** The installer runs on Windows 10 or 11. After the install, the Ledger opens in any browser, on any computer or phone.
- **The licence key** from your purchase email. It looks like `OL-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX`. One key is one business.
- **The business details:** the business name as it should appear on documents, the owner's email, and the 9-digit tax number (ת"ז for a sole trader, ח.פ. for a company). The key works for this tax number only.
- **An email address you read.** It becomes the owner's sign-in. Cloudflare sends a one-time code to it each time you sign in.
- **A credit card.** Cloudflare asks for one to turn on two free services, Zero Trust and R2. The free plans cost $0 and nothing is charged.

## Optional

You add each of these during the install or later.

- **A domain**, for example acme.co.il, already in your Cloudflare account. Without one, the Ledger runs on a free Cloudflare address ending in workers.dev. See [Domain or workers.dev](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/install/).
- **A Gemini or Anthropic API key**, so the Ledger reads receipts and supplier invoices for you. Without one, you type expense details by hand.
- **A Resend API key**, so the Ledger emails documents to clients. Resend needs a domain. Without one, you download each PDF or share it on WhatsApp.
- **A Slack webhook**, for alerts such as a Tax Authority login about to end.

## Who owns what

Everything is created in your own accounts, in your name: the Cloudflare account, the database, the files. MTN does not hold your data. The only link to MTN is the Tax Authority connection in the connected edition, which passes your allocation-number requests through MTN's approved app.

## Next

[Install with the installer](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/install/).

Still stuck? [Write to us from the pricing page.](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/pricing/#setup)

# Create the Cloudflare API token

The exact permission rows, account and zone settings for the installer's Cloudflare token, with and without a domain.

Updated 2026-10-17

The token is a password with limited rights. It lets the installer create the Ledger in your Cloudflare account. You delete it after the install.

## Open the token page

1. Open dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens in a new tab. Keep the installer open.
2. Click **Create Token**.
3. Scroll to the bottom of the list of templates. Find **Custom token** and click **Get started**.
4. Token name: anything, for example `Ledger install`.

## Add the permission rows

Each row has three boxes: the type (**Account** or **Zone**), the permission, and the level (**Read** or **Edit**). The first row is there already. Click **+ Add more** for each next row.

Add these six rows:

1. Account | Workers Scripts | Edit
2. Account | D1 | Edit
3. Account | Workers R2 Storage | Edit
4. Account | Access: Apps and Policies | Edit
5. Account | Access: Organizations, Identity Providers, and Groups | Read
6. Account | Account Settings | Read

Only if your account has a domain, add three more:

1. Zone | Zone | Read
2. Zone | Workers Routes | Edit
3. Zone | DNS | Edit

How to tell if you have a domain: on dash.cloudflare.com, the **Domains** list (on older menus, **Websites**) shows it. A new account has none.

## Account and zone resources

1. Below the permissions, under **Account Resources**, choose **Include**, then the business's account.
2. **Zone Resources** shows up only after you add a Zone row. With a domain: **Include**, then **Specific zone**, then the domain the Ledger will use. Without a domain you added no Zone rows, so this part does not show. Skip it.
3. **Client IP Address Filtering** and **TTL**: leave empty.

## Create and copy

1. Click **Continue to summary**, then **Create Token**.
2. Click **Copy** next to the token. Cloudflare shows it once. If you lose it, create a new one the same way.
3. Paste it in the installer and click **Check token**.

## If Check token fails

- **A permission is missing:** the message names it. Edit the token on the token page, add the row, save, and click **Check token** again. The token value stays the same.
- **Wrong account:** the token's **Account Resources** points at a different account. Edit it and pick the right one.
- **Pasted with a space:** copy it again with the **Copy** button.
- **Zero Trust or R2 not on yet:** finish step 1 of the installer first.

Still stuck? [Write to us from the pricing page.](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/pricing/#setup)

# Connect Claude or another AI app (MCP)

Give Claude Desktop or Claude Code access to your Ledger with the MCP address and token, and what to do when the token is lost.

Updated 2026-10-17

With MCP connected, you ask Claude things like "how much does Acme owe me" or "make a payment request for 3 hours of consulting", and Claude works in your Ledger. Claude creates drafts, and finalizes a document only after you confirm.

## What you need

- **The address:** your Ledger's address followed by `/mcp`, for example `https://ledger.acme.co.il/mcp`.
- **The token:** shown once on the installer's last screen.

## Claude Desktop

1. On the installer's last screen you clicked **Download for Claude Desktop**. The file `claude-desktop-<your address>.json` is in your Downloads folder.
2. In Claude Desktop: **Settings > Developer > Edit Config**. The file `claude_desktop_config.json` opens.
3. Copy the `open-ledger` entry from the downloaded file into `mcpServers` in that file. Save.
4. Restart Claude Desktop. This needs Node.js on the computer, from nodejs.org.

## Claude Code

Click **Download for Claude Code** on the installer's last screen and save the file as `.mcp.json` in the folder you work in. Or add the server with the address and the header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

## Lost the token

Cloudflare never shows a secret again, so you make a new token. The old one stops working at that moment.

### In the Ledger

1. Open **Settings > MCP**. Only an owner sees this tab.
2. Click **Make a new token**, then **Make the token** to confirm.
3. Copy the token, or click **Download for Claude Desktop** or **Download for Claude Code**. It is shown once.
4. Put it in the Claude config and restart Claude.

The same tab shows the MCP address with a **Copy** button, when the token was last used, and a switch that turns MCP off for every app.

### No MCP tab yet

The tab is in Ledgers updated after 17 October 2026. On an older Ledger, update first, see [Updates](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/updates-backups/). Or set the token in Cloudflare:

1. Look in Downloads for `claude-desktop-....json`. If it is there, the old token is inside and nothing else is needed.
2. Otherwise make a token in PowerShell on your computer:

`$b = New-Object byte 32; Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator::Create().GetBytes($b); Convert::ToBase64String($b)`

1. In dash.cloudflare.com: **Workers & Pages**, click **mtn-open-ledger**, then **Settings > Variables and Secrets**. Edit **MCP_TOKEN**, paste the line it printed, and click **Deploy**.

Still stuck? [Write to us from the pricing page.](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/pricing/#setup)

# Send documents by email, and keep them out of spam

Connect Resend so the Ledger emails receipts and invoices from your own domain, and the DNS and wording that keep them in the inbox.

Updated 2026-10-17

The Ledger sends email through Resend, a sending service with a free plan. Resend sends only from a domain you own and verify. Without a domain, download each PDF or use the WhatsApp button on the document page.

## Set up Resend

1. Sign up at resend.com.
2. Open **Domains**, click **Add Domain**, and type your domain, for example `acme.co.il`.
3. Resend shows DNS records: one or two for DKIM, one for SPF, and one MX on a `send.` subdomain. Add them where the domain's DNS lives. On Cloudflare, Resend offers to add them for you.
4. Wait for **Verified**. Minutes, sometimes an hour.
5. Open **API Keys**, click **Create API Key**, pick **Sending access**, and copy the key. It starts with `re_`.
6. Give it to the Ledger in the installer's Extras step, or later as the secret `MAIL_API_KEY` plus the variable `MAIL_FROM`, see [Add or change a key](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/keys-later/).

`MAIL_FROM` is the name and address clients see, for example `Acme Ltd <billing@acme.co.il>`. The address must be on the verified domain.

## Keep it out of spam

1. **DMARC.** Add a TXT record named `_dmarc` with the value `v=DMARC1; p=none;`. After two weeks of clean reports, change `p=none` to `p=quarantine`. Gmail and Yahoo expect a DMARC record from every sender.
2. **Turn off tracking.** In Resend, **Domains >** your domain **> Configuration**: turn off open tracking and click tracking. Tracking pixels and rewritten links push mail into Promotions and spam.
3. **A real reply address.** Send from an address that receives mail, such as `billing@` with a mailbox or forwarding behind it. Replies tell Gmail people want your mail.
4. **One sender for documents only.** Do not send newsletters from the address that sends receipts.
5. **Test once.** Send a receipt to your own Gmail, open it, click the three dots, **Show original**, and check that SPF, DKIM and DMARC all say **PASS**.

## The first email to a client

The Ledger asks for the client's consent before the first digital document. Ask the client to add your address to their contacts, and the next ones reach the inbox.

Still stuck? [Write to us from the pricing page.](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/pricing/#setup)

# Get your expenses into the Ledger

Upload receipts and supplier invoices, let AI read them, and import a month from Google Drive. Plus the email inbox that is coming.

Updated 2026-10-17

## Upload

The quickest way.

1. Open **Expenses** and click **Upload expense**.
2. Pick the file: PDF, JPG or PNG. On a phone, take a photo of the paper receipt.
3. With a Gemini or Anthropic key set, the Ledger reads the supplier, date, amounts and VAT, and fills them in. Check them and save.
4. Without a key, type the details yourself.

To add a reading key after the install, see [Add or change a key](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/keys-later/).

## A month from Google Drive

For people who already keep receipts in Drive, one folder per month named `YYYY-MM`, for example `2026-10`.

1. Follow the Drive setup in the repository: a Google Cloud project, the Drive and Sheets APIs, a service account, and the expenses folder shared with that account as Editor. The guide is `docs/drive-expenses-setup.md` on GitHub.
2. Give the Ledger the service account's JSON key as the secret `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON`, see [Add or change a key](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/keys-later/).
3. In **Settings > Expenses**, paste the folder id, the part of the folder's address after `/folders/`, and click **Save folder**.
4. In **Expenses**, pick the month and click **Import month**. Each file goes through AI reading and waits for your check. Running it twice adds nothing twice.
5. To import every morning, turn on **Daily sync** in **Settings > Expenses**.

## Coming: forward receipts by email

We are building a private email address for each Ledger. You set one rule in Gmail or Outlook that forwards receipts to it, and every receipt lands in **Expenses** read and waiting for your check. No Drive, no Google Cloud. This page will explain the setup once it ships.

Still stuck? [Write to us from the pricing page.](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/pricing/#setup)

# From quote to receipt: your first documents

The order of documents in the Ledger, from a quote and a payment request to the receipt, and why the receipt is the one that counts.

Updated 2026-10-17

## The order

1. **Quote:** the price you offer. No tax meaning.
2. **Payment request** (דרישת תשלום): asks for the money. No tax meaning either.
3. **Receipt**, or for an עוסק מורשה a **tax invoice/receipt:** issued when the money arrives. This is the document that counts as income.

You skip steps you do not need. A client who already paid gets a receipt straight away.

## Make a payment request

1. Click **Create new**, then **Payment Request**.
2. Pick the client or add a new one. Add the lines: a service from **Services**, or free text, quantity and price.
3. Tick the payment methods to show.
4. Click **Save and finalize**. Finalizing gives it a number and locks it.
5. Send it: by email from the document page, or with the WhatsApp button, or download the PDF.

## When the money arrives

1. Open the payment request. In the list it has a **Record payment** button.
2. Fill in how and when the client paid, and the amount.
3. Confirm. The Ledger issues the receipt, numbered and signed, and links it to the request.
4. Send the receipt the same way.

## Mistakes

- **Before you send:Cancel** on the document page.
- **After you send:** a final document never changes. Open the receipt and click **Issue credit** for all or part of it.

## Recurring

For a monthly retainer, **Income > Recurring** issues a payment request or a receipt every month, and sends it if you choose **Issue and send automatically**.

Still stuck? [Write to us from the pricing page.](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/pricing/#setup)

# First sign-in and setup

Sign in to your Ledger for the first time, fill in the business profile, logo, signature and numbering, and check one receipt before you go live.

Updated 2026-10-17

## Sign in

1. Open the Ledger's address from the installer's last screen or the Desktop summary.
2. Cloudflare shows its sign-in page. Type the owner email and click **Send me a code**.
3. Copy the code from the email and paste it. You are in.

Every sign-in works this way. A person whose email is not on the list never reaches the Ledger, Cloudflare stops them first.

## Business profile

The first sign-in opens the setup screen. The Ledger creates no document until the required fields hold a value: the business name in English and Hebrew, the tax number and the address. The same form lives in **Settings > Business**.

Optional fields print on documents when set: tagline, email, phone, website, and on payment requests also bank details and payment links.

## Logo and signature

- **Settings > Business > Logo > Upload image.** PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, up to 2 MB.
- **Settings > Signature > Signature image > Upload image.** A transparent PNG works best. It prints above the signer line on every issued document.

## Numbering, if you used another system before

**Settings > Numbering** lists one series per document type, each starting at 1. If you issued receipts or invoices in another system this year, set each series to one more than the last number you issued there.

Do this before the first document in that series. The start number locks the moment a document takes a number, and the Ledger refuses any later change.

## Payment methods

**Settings > Payment methods.** Add the ways clients pay you: bank transfer with your account details, Bit, card, a payment link. Payment requests list the ones you tick.

## Check before you go live

1. Issue one receipt to yourself for a small amount.
2. Open the client copy and the filed copy. Check the header, the tax number, the logo and the signature.
3. Check with your accountant: the document types you need, the business type, and sending documents digitally.

## Next

[From quote to receipt](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/first-invoice/).

Still stuck? [Write to us from the pricing page.](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/pricing/#setup)

# Install Open Ledger IL step by step

Every screen of the Windows installer, from the licence key to the Ledger's address, with what to fill in and what to skip.

Updated 2026-10-17

Read [Before you install](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/before-you-start/) first. Keep the purchase email open, you need the key and the download link.

## 1. Download and open the installer

1. Click the download link in the purchase email. The file is `MTN-Open-Ledger-Setup-relay-1.6.0.exe`, about 100 MB.
2. The link works for 72 hours and 5 downloads. If it no longer works, open it anyway and click **Email me a fresh link**.
3. Double-click the file. Windows shows **Windows protected your PC**. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. The file is not signed with a paid certificate yet, so Windows warns about every new copy.
4. The installer opens in your browser. Keep that browser tab and the small black window open until the end. Closing either one stops the install.

## 2. Licence key and business

1. Paste the licence key and the business tax number.
2. Fill in the business name, the owner email and the business type: עוסק פטור, עוסק מורשה or חברה בע"מ. The Ledger asks once more on its first screen, so a mistake here is easy to fix.
3. Under **More people who may sign in**, add your accountant or a second email of your own, one per line. You also add people later, see [Give your accountant access](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/users/).

## 3. Cloudflare account

The Ledger runs in your own Cloudflare account. The installer shows three steps, in order.

1. **No Cloudflare account yet?** Sign up at dash.cloudflare.com/sign-up with the business email and verify the email. Skip any offer to add a website.
2. **Turn on Zero Trust and R2.** Click **Show me how** on that step. Both are free, and both ask for a card. Do not create a bucket, the installer does that. Tick **I did it**.
3. **Create the API token.** Follow [Create the Cloudflare API token](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/cloudflare-token/). This is the step where most people get stuck. Tick **I did it**.
4. Paste the token and click **Check token**. Pick the account.

## 4. Domain or workers.dev

After the token check, the installer asks for the Ledger's web address.

- **With a domain in Cloudflare:** type an address on it, for example `ledger.acme.co.il`. The installer creates it.
- **Without a domain:** tick **Use the free Cloudflare address instead of a domain** and choose a workers.dev name, for example the business name in English. Clients see this address in the links you send. Moving to your own domain later changes the address.

## 5. Tax Authority

Pick how the Ledger gets allocation numbers for tax invoices. The connected edition fills this in for you: the Ledger connects through MTN, with nothing to type. After the install you sign in once with your Tax Authority user, see [Connect to the Tax Authority](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/tax-authority/).

## 6. Extras

All optional. Each **?** button explains where to get the key.

- **Expense reading:** pick Gemini or Anthropic and paste the key. A Gemini key from aistudio.google.com starts with `AQ.`, older ones with `AIza`.
- **Email sending:** the Resend API key and the sender, written as `Business Name <billing@your-domain.co.il>`. See [Send documents by email](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/email/).
- **Slack alerts:** the webhook address.

Skip anything you do not have. You add it later, see [Add or change a key after the install](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/keys-later/).

## 7. Install and finish

1. Check the summary and click **Install**. It takes about 3 minutes.
2. The last screen shows the Ledger's address and an **MCP token**. Copy the token now, or click one of the download buttons. Cloudflare never shows it again. See [Connect Claude](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/connect-claude/).
3. The installer leaves a summary file on the Desktop, without secrets.
4. Delete the Cloudflare API token: dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens, the three dots next to the token, **Delete**. The Ledger does not need it any more.

## Next

[First sign-in and setup](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/first-sign-in/).

Still stuck? [Write to us from the pricing page.](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/pricing/#setup)

- [Create the Cloudflare API token](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/cloudflare-token/)
- [First sign-in and setup](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/first-sign-in/)
- [Give your accountant or assistant access](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/users/)

# Add or change a key after the install

Add the Gemini, Anthropic, Resend, Slack or Google Drive key to your Ledger in the Cloudflare dashboard, without running the installer again.

Updated 2026-10-17

The Ledger reads its keys from its Worker in Cloudflare. A Worker is the program that runs the Ledger. You add or change a key there.

## Where

1. Sign in at dash.cloudflare.com.
2. Open **Workers & Pages** and click **mtn-open-ledger**.
3. Open **Settings**, then **Variables and Secrets**.
4. Click **+ Add**. Pick **Secret** for keys and **Text** for plain settings. Type the name, paste the value.
5. Click **Deploy**. The Ledger uses the new value within a minute.

Names are exact, in capital letters.

## Which names

- **Receipt reading with Gemini:** Secret `GEMINI_API_KEY` with the key, and Text `AI_PROVIDER` with the value `gemini`.
- **Receipt reading with Anthropic:** Secret `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` with the key, and Text `AI_PROVIDER` with the value `anthropic`.
- **Email sending:** Secret `MAIL_API_KEY` with the Resend key, and Text `MAIL_FROM` with the sender, for example `Acme Ltd <billing@acme.co.il>`.
- **Slack alerts:** Secret `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL`.
- **Google Drive expenses:** Secret `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON` with the whole content of the JSON key file, from the first `{` to the last `}`.
- **MCP token:** Secret `MCP_TOKEN`, see [Connect Claude](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/connect-claude/).

## Rules

- Never paste a key in an email, a chat or a document. Paste it only into Cloudflare or the installer.
- If a key leaks, make a new one at the provider, delete the old one there, and replace it here.

Still stuck? [Write to us from the pricing page.](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/pricing/#setup)

# Take payments with Grow, Cardcom or another provider

Use a card payment provider for collecting money and the Ledger for the receipts, by hand or automatically, without two documents for one payment.

Updated 2026-10-17

The Ledger issues the documents. A payment provider such as Grow, Cardcom, PayPlus or Bit collects the money. The two work side by side.

## First: turn off the provider's documents

Most providers issue their own receipt or invoice for every payment. Turn that off in the provider's settings, or ask their support to. Otherwise every payment gets two documents with two different numbers, and your books stop matching the bank.

## Way 1: by hand

1. In the Ledger, add the provider's payment link as a payment method: **Settings > Payment methods**, type **Card** or **Other**, paste the link.
2. Send the client a payment request with that method ticked.
3. When the provider tells you the money arrived, open the payment request and click **Record payment**. Pick **Card**, and paste the provider's transaction number as the reference.
4. The Ledger issues the receipt. Send it to the client.

Two minutes per payment. Fits a business with a few payments a week.

## Way 2: automatic, for technical users

The Ledger has an MCP endpoint, a door for other software, at its address followed by `/mcp`. It takes JSON-RPC calls (`tools/call`) with the header `Authorization: Bearer` and your MCP token. The tools include `list_clients`, `create_draft`, `finalize_document` and `record_payment`.

An automation tool such as Make, Zapier or n8n connects the provider to it:

1. In the provider, turn on the webhook for successful payments and point it at a new scenario.
2. In the scenario, find the client with `list_clients`, using the payer's name or email.
3. Record the payment against the open payment request with `record_payment` and `confirm: true`. The scenario needs the payment request's document id. Keep a small table of payment link to document id, filled when you send each request.
4. The Ledger issues the receipt.

This takes an afternoon to set up and test. Start with one small payment. For the MCP token, see [Connect Claude or another app](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/connect-claude/).

Still stuck? [Write to us from the pricing page.](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/pricing/#setup)

# Connect to the Tax Authority for allocation numbers

Sign the Ledger in to the Israel Tax Authority once, so tax invoices get their allocation numbers by themselves, and reconnect every 90 days.

Updated 2026-10-17

A tax invoice to an Israeli עוסק מורשה above the threshold needs an allocation number (מספר הקצאה) from the Tax Authority. With the connection, the Ledger asks for the number when you finalize the invoice and prints it on the document.

An עוסק פטור issues no tax invoices, so it needs no connection. Connect later, when you become עוסק מורשה.

## Connect

1. In the Ledger, open **ITA** in the sidebar.
2. Click **Connect to ITA**.
3. The Tax Authority's sign-in page opens. Sign in with your Tax Authority user: the user code and the one-time code sent to your phone. Use the business's own user, the one for its tax number.
4. Approve the request. You come back to the Ledger, and the page shows **Connected**, with the number of days left.

The connected edition goes through MTN's approved Tax Authority app, so there is no app of your own to register.

## Every 90 days

The Tax Authority login lasts 90 days. The ITA page shows **Login ends in N days**. With Slack alerts on, the Ledger warns you before. When it ends, open **ITA** and click **Connect again**. An invoice still waiting for a number shows in the **Allocation queue** on the same page. After you reconnect, click **Retry now**.

## When a number is refused

The ITA page shows the reason. The choices are to cancel the invoice, continue without a number with a notice on the document, or switch to reverse charge with the client's agreement. Ask your accountant which fits.

Still stuck? [Write to us from the pricing page.](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/pricing/#setup)

# Common problems and how to fix them

Fixes for the places people get stuck: Windows warnings, the Cloudflare token, Zero Trust, keys the installer refuses, sign-in, downloads and email.

Updated 2026-10-17

## The installer

- **Windows protected your PC.** Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **The antivirus removed the file.** Restore it from the antivirus quarantine and allow it, or download it again from the purchase email.
- **Nothing opens after double-click.** Wait 20 seconds, the file is large. The installer opens a browser tab at an address starting with `http://127.0.0.1`. If no tab opens, copy that address from the small black window into your browser.
- **The licence key is refused.** Type it as `OL-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX`, and check the tax number. The key works only for the tax number it was bought for. Reinstalling the same business with the same key is fine.

## Cloudflare

- **Zone Resources is missing.** It shows up only after a Zone permission row. Without a domain, skip it and use the free workers.dev address. See [Create the Cloudflare API token](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/cloudflare-token/).
- **Check token fails.** The message names the missing permission. Edit the token, add the row, save, and check again.
- **Zero Trust or R2 asks for a card.** Both free plans ask for a payment method and charge nothing.
- **Purchase R2 Plan.** Click it and confirm the free tier. The first 10 GB a month are free.

## Keys

- **A Gemini key is refused.** New keys from Google AI Studio start with `AQ.`. The installer from version 1.6.0 of 17 October 2026 accepts them. With an older installer, pick **No** for expense reading and add the key afterwards, see [Add or change a key](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/keys-later/).
- **An Anthropic key is refused.** It starts with `sk-ant-`. Copy it again from console.anthropic.com.

## Signing in

- **A Cloudflare page asks for an email.** That is the sign-in. Type the owner email and paste the code from the email.
- **No code arrives.** Check spam, and check that the email is the one given in the installer.
- **Someone else is stopped at the Cloudflare page.** Add their email in Cloudflare Access, see [Give your accountant access](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/users/).

## Downloads and email

- **The download link says it expired or ran out.** Click **Email me a fresh link** on that page.
- **Clients get your documents in spam.** See [Keep them out of spam](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/email/).
- **Lost the MCP token.** See [Connect Claude](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/help/connect-claude/).

## Tax Authority

- **ITA says reconnect.** The login lasts 90 days. Open **ITA** and click **Connect again**.
- **An invoice waits for a number for 24 hours.** Request the number in the Tax Authority web app and type it on the ITA page.

Still stuck? [Write to us from the pricing page.](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/pricing/#setup)

# Updates and backups

How to check for a new Open Ledger IL version and update with the installer, and where the Ledger keeps its backups.

Updated 2026-10-17

## Check for updates

**Settings > Updates > Check for updates.** The Ledger also checks on the 1st of each month. Nothing installs by itself.

## Update

1. Open the download link from your purchase email. If it no longer works, open it anyway and click **Email me a fresh link**.
2. Run the new installer on the same Cloudflare account, with the same licence key.
3. It updates the Ledger and keeps everything: the database, the files, the sign-in and your keys.

## Backups

- Every quarter, the Ledger writes a full copy of its database and a list of every file to its own backup bucket, and tests that the copy restores.
- With Google Drive connected, the same copy also goes to your Drive, outside Cloudflare.
- Every night it checks the numbering for gaps and the documents for changes. **Settings > Backups > Run check now** runs the check on demand.

## Keep Cloudflare safe

The Cloudflare account holds your books. Turn on two-factor sign-in: dash.cloudflare.com, your profile, **Authentication**, **Two-Factor Authentication**.

Still stuck? [Write to us from the pricing page.](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/pricing/#setup)

# Give your accountant or assistant access

Add an accountant, an assistant or your second email to the Ledger, in the Ledger and in Cloudflare Access, and remove them again.

Updated 2026-10-17

Each person gets a role per business.

- **Owner:** everything, including Settings, users, numbering and the Tax Authority connection.
- **Assistant:** clients, quotes, payment requests, receipts, sending and expenses. No Settings, users or Tax Authority.
- **Accountant:** reads what you allow, until an end date. Every request is logged. An accountant never issues or cancels a document.

## Add a person

Two places, both needed.

### 1. In the Ledger

1. Pick the business in the switcher at the top.
2. In the sidebar, open **Accountant > Users**.
3. Click **Invite someone**.
4. Type the email and pick the role. An accountant also needs an end date and the feature switches: income documents, expenses, reports, the monthly pack, the unified file.
5. Click **Send invite**.

For your own second email, pick **Owner**.

### 2. In Cloudflare Access

Emails you listed in the installer are there already. For anyone new:

1. Sign in at dash.cloudflare.com and open **Zero Trust**.
2. Go to **Access > Applications** and open **MTN Open Ledger**.
3. Open the **Policies** tab and edit the sign-in policy.
4. Under **Include > Emails**, add the email.
5. Click **Save**.

Until step 5, Cloudflare stops the person at its own sign-in page.

## Remove a person

1. In the Ledger: **Accountant > Users**, click **Revoke** on the row.
2. In Cloudflare Access: remove the email from **Include > Emails** and save.

Still stuck? [Write to us from the pricing page.](https://open-ledger.matanlevanon.com/pricing/#setup)
